scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.postinstall: node -e "try { const p = require('ffmpeg-static'); const fs = require('fs'); if (!p || !fs.existsSync(p)) { require('child_process').execSync('node ' + require.resolve('ffmpeg-static/install.js'), { stdio: 'inherit' }); } if (p && fs.existsSync(p) && process.platform !== 'win32') fs.chmodSync(p, 0o755); } catch(e){}"
